statement: An opt-in Wii Remote Plus TR creation variant should be validated separately from Original against kernel-bound Linux/xwiimote, SDL kernel-managed detection, Dolphin ControllerInterface and Cemu setup plus decoded gyro oracles. Unbinding hid-wiimote is not a general test precondition; W9e unbound native tests are owner-run test builds gated by virtualgamepad issue 258. The already-existing WiiRemoteRevision Tr inside virtualgamepad can keep registry family virtualgamepad.wii-remote with a separate revision manifest/acceptance matrix; a new public virtualgamepad.wii-remote-plus ID requires explicit owner API/catalog decision. All proposed tests not run.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux v6.12 core 811-905, SDL driver 385-491, Dolphin CI 449-657, Cemu 239-380, xwiimote core 611-672; model code referenced in docs at pinned virtualgamepad commit 1c810c5. No host/physical run. All acceptance/physical experiments explicitly not run.
